'''Yugo Takahashi''' (Japanese: '''高橋裕吾''' ''Takahashi Yūgo'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Takahashi was born sometime on November 13 in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actor as an adult. He first provided the voice of Kail, one of the [[Invincible Pokémon Brothers]], during {{aniseries|GS}}, as well as in [[Pokémon Chronicles]]. Takahashi is currently affiliated with the talent agency {{wp|Aoni Production}}.
